steps.what: Verify departure, arrival, delay, aircraft and airfield status from current operational sources
Assemble status information into the required agency message format
Check and relay status information to upline controlling agencies

tasks.design: Configure message assembly in {OPS_SYSTEM} from specialist-checked entries. The specialist verifies currency, resolves inconsistencies and relays the final message through approved operational channels.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeating checked movement and status fields in standard messages can require manual assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed templates can reuse explicit fields without interpreting operational significance.
tasks.still_hard: Timeliness, conflicting updates and deciding what agencies need to know.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising operational consequences and ensuring the recipient understands the update.
tasks.altitude: Reduce limited message preparation while retaining operational communication responsibility.

evidence.claim: Fixed operational status fields can populate message templates; the task-specific saving and interface availability are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is status preparation and relay to upline agencies; general message traffic and aircraft-control decisions are separate. Shared communications must be allocated once in roll-ups.

Specialist captures movement ID, event type, actual or estimated time, delay reason, aircraft status, airfield status, source, verification time and recipient in s1, including capture and source confirmation. No ready-made operational status flag is assumed.
Test native message templates first. Missing, stale or conflicting fields require manual preparation and clarification; automatic transmission is not proposed.
Existing agency updates and field observations are unchanged inputs; no extra structured reporting is imposed on their producers.
unknowns: Approved message formats and operational interfaces
research_questions: Does template assembly reduce effort after source verification and final communication are counted?

already_counted.description: Final check, relay and communication record

incremental.description: Message template and freshness rule upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Movement, event times, status fields, verification time, recipient and final message; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross25 minus focal upkeep8 gives net17. Range allows existing message population and frequent status changes to absorb most or all benefit; communication stays fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support aircrew information and planning needs

steps.what: Provide aircrews with current information and services for airfield management and flight planning

tasks.design: Retain aircrew briefing and service guidance, using current information in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The digest describes flight-planning tools, but it does not establish a removable briefing workload for this airfield task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The required information depends on the flight and current airfield situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing operational information supports the specialist's briefing.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising missing context and clarifying operational implications.
tasks.human_edge: Answering the crew's actual question and checking mutual understanding.
tasks.altitude: Briefing authority and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Lido Flight 4D provides flight planning against weather and airspace restrictions; this does not demonstrate reduced airfield specialist briefing time.

assumptions: Boundary covers responding to aircrew information and service needs, excluding constructing flight plans and separate agency status relay.
Specialist obtains and verifies current information within s1 from existing operational sources; no prevalidated flight-specific briefing or structured service readiness flag is assumed.
Test native information retrieval before custom code; no new automation is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because briefing and existing source access remain unchanged.
research_questions: Can observed briefings isolate repeated information assembly from contextual discussion?

already_counted.description: Information retrieval, verification and aircrew briefing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Retrieval, source checking and crew discussion remain counted; flight-planning computation is outside this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Coordinate agencies for billeting, messing, refueling, transportation and transient aircraft maintenance

tasks.design: Retain agency coordination through existing {TELEPHONY} and {EMAIL} channels. Availability, suitability and commitments must be confirmed by the responsible agencies; no structured live booking feed is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support arrangements depend on several agencies and changing requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication channels remain usable without a new system.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting availability and confirming service suitability.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating workable arrangements and escalating unmet needs.
tasks.altitude: Coordination responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Local support procedures and maintenance boundaries

evidence.claim: Multi-agency support coordination requires contextual confirmation and negotiation; no task-specific saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is arranging support, excluding agencies' provision of accommodation, food, fuel, transport or maintenance.
Specialist gathers crew requirements and agency confirmations during s1; agency responses are produced after each request, not assumed available in advance.
Test native contact and request features before custom code; no new structured agency reporting or booking integration is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the current coordination method and outside service labour remain unchanged.
unknowns: Whether repeated service requests have stable templates
research_questions: Is repeated copying a measurable part of coordination after availability confirmation?

already_counted.description: Requirements gathering, agency contacts and confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Agency negotiation and confirmation retain full time; outside service work receives no savings credit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive, transmit and control message traffic, resolving ambiguity and confirming critical communications

tasks.design: Retain operational message control with the specialist using approved {TELEPHONY} and {OPS_SYSTEM} channels. Automatic interpretation or routing is not proposed without an established message contract and operational validation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Message significance depends on context and timing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved communications support receipt and acknowledgement.
tasks.still_hard: Prioritising urgent traffic and resolving unclear or conflicting messages.
tasks.human_edge: Detecting ambiguity and ensuring critical information reaches the right person.
tasks.altitude: Operational communication authority and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Controlling operational message traffic requires contextual judgement; no task-specific labour reduction is established.

assumptions: Boundary is general message traffic control; specific status report assembly and relay are allocated to the status task and must not be counted twice.
Message originators produce incoming communications in the existing workflow; specialist interpretation and clarification remain in s1. No structured urgency, intent or routing flag is assumed.
Test native communication features before custom code; no new automation is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because approved communications remain unchanged.
unknowns: Current message channels and acknowledgement requirements
research_questions: Are any repeated non-operational copying steps separable from message control?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Operational message handling retains full time; specific status reporting belongs to its separate task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains operational judgement and communications with limited checked-message assembly support.
reach: Improve status and service handoffs with operational partners
role.ambitious_version: Use verified report preparation gains to protect time for operational clarification and coordination.
